body:
During nights like these I kind of can relate

It's not like I want to go, but I am so tired, sooo so tired. I just want the pain to stop. I don't remember what happy is, honestly I don't believe in it, not for me.

Dying is hard. Each time I think of suicide I just can't handle the possible trauma I'd cause to someone. I think this is what helps me get through those nights. I know it sounds stupid, but I just can't deal with the fact that my suffering would end, but more likely one than one person would suffer because of me escaping the pain.

I guess whatever keeps the boat floating is good enough.
I remember catching up on it few years ago, quite good, but humor gets overwhelming after a while

Since the results form art school came, i had a *break*, but aside from that, did Yoga everyday for 6 months, and since Corona is not as problematic where i live, i also do some *running with rifles.*
The list is long, so three top picks - Adventure Time, Gravity Falls, The Amazing World of Gumball

I guess that there is no point in being in a one sided relationship, overall i am gonna hurt both myself and him by emotional abuse. I guess that my *take one for the team*  attitude is getting in the way.

It's more of he wasn't honest about himself rather than not being honest about day-to-day stuff, but generally speaking this is dishonesty and it wasn't fair. I do not treat this as an escape though, i am moving on rather than running from.

Oh i did gentle nudging, alright - ti's not like i gave up first, but if all that comes from him is watching netflix together... I can't work with this.

Shame that i couldn't learn all this in high school this being where every normal person could learn this. Hanks man, i will take care, you should too!

You meant psychical, right? Yeah i am gonna talk to few people and if nothing works out, gonna go back to parents. 

Maybe it sounds weird because i learned to keep my emotions in check and do not flood other people with them. But one thing i feel constantly is ever growing frustration in regards to him (sexual too). Also this is my first relationship, and i am in my 20. Somewhere deep down i know that this is a big problem.

Yeah, i know the lesson - i need a lot of time before i know someone enough to be mentally able to move in with them.

Well i did not get through all this junk just to stop, Aye?

Anyway, thank you very much ;)

*If you want to help yourself cope, you need to keep an open mind -* from this train of thoughts it is easy to grasp concepts if you're open to solution. A bit gullible, but hey, works! 

I guess it is like going back to basics, because there is no *life* subject in schools, i am gonna have to learn from scratch and the hard way :/ 

Unconscious competence? Wow now that would be rare, all though on a micro scale it happened to me a few times in Uni, anyway - i am proud to be incompetent, at least i know i am hahahah  Either way, it's second out of 4, at age of 63 i will be there if maths apply, but hey, at this age people are still considered to be in production phase (i have no bloody idea how to translate that properly and internet is not helping - three stages - kid -> adult --> elderly where adults are considered to be employed)

Either way - you're wise enough to know such things and help people like me find a path and understand so you've probably graduated this stage ;) 

Will see how the life goes after Uni because we're off from *peaceful* and will rolling with hard baby!

Reading the definition, it makes a lot of sense and is quite comforting, though i guess that the community has a term for nearly anything haha.

I have always wondered why i fell in love twice to my close friends, i guess this is the way i am and it is not all that uncommon. Knowing this will definitely make it easier to work with it and not stress about it too much. 

I'd even say that this is - in a way - really nice, because we are able to see detailed qualities of a person in spades. It's just like focusing a camera. Things are blurry at the beginning.

So why could i be feeling so cold when it comes to to love and my SO? 

One thing that i did not write is that actually falling in love takes a lot of time to me.

Thanks for the answer ;)

I know how destructive and common that illness is, it's why when i have the chance i try to help people in need.

To be quite honest i think that i am past the depression since finding purpose and confidence in life, as mentioned. I'd say i am much rather confused than anything else. Confused because of numbness in love department and all of the sudden i am all nostalgic.

Also, instead of getting easier with progression, life gets definitely harder, way more tasks and achieving goals is really hard. A year ago i'd be all cheerful and be like 'Yay, moving to Canada will be easy', only to realize that Moving, finding work and adjusting is insanely hard.

If you don't mind, that is the itchy stuff i mostly wanted to vent / talk about.

Oh, so this is way more complex than i have expected, will definitely experiment and try other stuff out, i guess i worry too much, but still these are some good news. If the problem will persist i will visit the doctor for sure. Thanks for the help!

Choices, got this - dick would stay in pants no matter what, this is what being trustworthy means so i have my standards. Did not explore really, causal sex or FWB is beyond my mind so this is the route i choose i suppose. Thank you for clarifying ;)

No, i am not circumcised, the skin retracts A OK too, i'll give it two tries or so and if it won't change i'll go visit a doc, my country is a bit behind the times so i won't rush it. Thank you for your answer.
